sinopsis.es: La carretera parece seguir tranquila, en línea recta, por el desierto de Nevada. En 1959, es hacia allá que una profesora neoyorquina debe dirigirse para conseguir el divorcio de su marido. Contra lo esperado, aparece la atrevida Cay, que cambia el rumbo del destino a la velocidad de las grandes pasiones. Basada en el libro de Jane Rule.
sinopsis.en: The road seems to stretch smoothly in a straight line through the Nevada desert. In 1959, this is the direction a New York teacher must head to get a divorce from her husband. But then, unexpectedly, the audacious Cay appears, redirecting the course of destiny with the high speed typical of great passions. Donna Deitch's debut film, based on Jane Rule's book, is a classic of lesbian cinema that reimagined the narrative possibilities of love between women for a wide audience.
